hederaTestnet.note: Agent identity is HCS-14-style (uaid:aid:hedera:testnet:0.0.x) published to the registry topic via the Hedera Agent Kit; staking/slash is native-HBAR escrow via the Hedera SDK. Reputation is an HTS ReputationBond token (bondToken, set by `pnpm setup-hts`) with a custom fractional fee + freeze/pause/wipe compliance controls; on fraud the verifier destroys it with a 2-of-2 multi-sig TokenWipe (verifier + auditor). No Solidity anywhere — HCS + HTS + Mirror Node, all SDK-native.
